description_en: Retrieves the information of a specific user
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The user UID. You can view your UID by clicking the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console
parameters.help_zh: 用户UID。您可以通过DMS控制台右上角头像处查看您的UID
parameters.name: uid

parameters.help_en: The user ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: user_id

Success.description_en:
Specifies whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

CurExecuteCount.description_en: The number of queries on the current day

CurResultCount.description_en: The number of queried rows on the current day

DingRobot.description_en:
The DingTalk chatbot used to receive message notifications.

If you have configured a DingTalk chatbot in the Notification settings by clicking the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console, this parameter is returned.
If you have not configured a DingTalk chatbot, this parameter is not returned
DingRobot.description_zh:
钉钉机器人，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过钉钉机器人，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过钉钉机器人，此处则没有返回

Email.description_en:
The email address used to receive message notifications.

If you have configured an email address in the Notification settings by clicking the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console, this parameter is returned.
If you have not configured an email address, this parameter is not returned
Email.description_zh:
电子邮箱，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过电子邮箱，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过电子邮箱，此处则没有返回

LastLoginTime.description_en: The time when the user last logged on to the console

MaxExecuteCount.description_en: The maximum number of queries on the current day

MaxResultCount.description_en: The maximum number of queried rows on the current day

Mobile.description_en:
The mobile phone number of the user.

If you have configured a mobile phone number in the Notification settings by clicking the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console, this parameter is returned.
If you have not configured a mobile phone number, this parameter is not returned
Mobile.description_zh:
用户手机号码。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过手机号码，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过手机号码，此处则没有返回

NotificationMode.description_en:
The notification methods. Multiple values may be returned. Valid values:

SMS: text message
EMAIL: email
DINGDING: DingTalk
DINGROBOT: DingTalk chatbot
WEBHOOK: webhook
NotificationMode.description_zh:
消息通知方式，返回值可能为多个值，单个返回值说明如下：

SMS：短信
EMAIL：电子邮箱
DINGDING：钉钉
DINGROBOT：钉钉机器人
WEBHOOK：Webhook

ParentUid.description_en:
The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
A single Alibaba Cloud account UID can contain multiple RAM user UIDs
ParentUid.description_zh:
主账号UID。
同一主账号UID下包含多个子账号UID

SignatureMethod.description_en:
The signature method for the webhook. Valid values:
NONE: no signature
HMAC_SHA1: HMAC_SHA1
SignatureMethod.description_zh:
Webhook签名方式。返回值说明如下：
NONE：不签名
HMAC_SHA1：HMAC_SHA1

State.description_en:
The user state. Valid values:
NORMAL: normal
DISABLE: disabled
DELETE: deleted
State.description_zh:
用户状态，返回值说明如下：
NORMAL：正常
DISABLE：禁用
DELETE：已删除

Uid.description_en: The UID of the target user

Webhook.description_en:
The webhook used to receive message notifications.

If you have configured a webhook, the system sends message notifications to the specified URL when notifications are generated in DMS.
If you have not configured a webhook, this parameter is not returned
Webhook.description_zh:
Webhook，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经配置过Webhook，当DMS中有消息通知时，系统会将消息通知发送到您指定的URL地址。
如果您没有配置过，此处则没有返回
